name: Jean-Marc Germain, Monika Hohlmeier - § 13 - Am 10
title: REPORT on the implementation of the rule of law conditionality regime
part_text: 13. Emphasises that in October 2021, following repeated calls on the Commission to act, Parliament launched an action against the Commission before the CJEU pursuant to Article 265 TFEU over its failure to act and apply the regulation, which was later withdrawn; recalls that this action clearly shows that Parliament’s political blackmailing led to the triggering of the rule of law procedure against some Member States;
